plugins.name: outbound-engine
plugins.description: 34 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting). A master skill routes the ten-step path and enforces the gate between steps: ICP and personas, signal catalog, ATS job-posting sourcing, niche data-source discovery, signal and data-point research over an existing base, a full raw-list-to-campaigns run, prospect-list research with per-row costs, contact and email enrichment through a priced cascade, two-stage scoring (pre-contact and post-contact), angle finding, sequence copy with interest-only CTAs, a cold-email infrastructure and copy-framework playbook, a personalization pipeline, a pre-launch data check, deliverability, per-reply objection handling, forensic reply audits, A/B analysis, benchmark verdicts on outbound metrics and weekly reporting. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
